# ADhammer

> ADhammer is an open-source (MIT) Active Directory pentest and security-assessment tool in Rust. It collects a domain over LDAP, builds an attack-path graph to Tier-0, validates supported findings with captured proof, and reports findings as JSON, HTML, Markdown, and BloodHound-CE. It ships as one static binary and is also usable as a Rust library.

## What it is
- Language: Rust. Version 1.5.2 is available as GitHub binaries and a crates.io CLI package.
- Author / org: zevs / icedracon — https://github.com/icedracon
- License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/icedracon/adhammer

## Capabilities
- Collect: LDAP objects, ACEs, trusts, AD CS, delegation, and security posture into one typed in-memory model.
- Graph: directional control edges; resolves the cheapest viable path to Tier-0; exports BloodHound-CE.
- Attack / validate: AD CS ESC coverage, Kerberoasting, DCSync, RBCD, Zerologon safe-detect, and more — each hop is promoted from POSSIBLE to PROVEN only when supported by concrete evidence.
- Report: JSON, HTML, Markdown, and BloodHound-CE; finding, path, proof, command, and MITRE technique stay linked across every export.

## Current release
- Version 1.5.2 was published on GitHub Releases on 2026-09-19 and crates.io on 2026-09-20. The CLI registry version was verified unyanked on 2026-09-20.
- The tagged changelog documents quiet/no-color scripting controls, build provenance, print-ready HTML, report schema versioning, correctness fixes, and dependency hardening.
- Native-speed mode uses `--fast` or `ADHAMMER_FAST=1`. In v1.5.2 it affects selected WMI readback delays and deep network-probe timeouts, not doctor/template-check runtime or the basic sweep's fixed timeouts. Shorter timeouts can miss slow responses; target-protection controls remain unchanged.
- These are documented release changes, not a new live-validation claim. Partial and unvalidated paths retain their stated limits; `docs/VALIDATION.md` remains authoritative for support.
- The GitHub release lists Windows, Linux, and macOS downloads with SHA-256 sidecars and attestation verification instructions.
- Version 1.5.1 is the previous GitHub release; version 1.5.0 is the earlier first-touch assessment release.
- The website includes six source-checked defensive CLI examples and three silent illustrative video loops. These are not live assessment recordings or new validation receipts.

## Who it is for
- Penetration testers, red teamers, and Active Directory security specialists.
- Built on the icedracon ecosystem of published standalone Rust crates implementing Microsoft security protocols.

## Links
- CLI registry install: `cargo install --locked adhammer@1.5.2` — https://crates.io/crates/adhammer/1.5.2
- Library: `cargo add adhammer-sdk`
- Source: https://github.com/icedracon/adhammer
- Release downloads: https://github.com/icedracon/adhammer/releases/tag/v1.5.2

- Ecosystem repositories: https://github.com/icedracon?tab=repositories

## Authorized use only
ADhammer implements working offensive security techniques. Use it exclusively against systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test.
